resolved_binding_work.argument: Work pointwise, so no global symmetric-sum descent or coarse etaleness is needed. Take an actual geometric supersingular enhanced pair over a finite residue field. Lift its Weierstrass coefficients to a characteristic-zero complete DVR with that residue field; the discriminant stays a unit. Since ell0 does not divide Np, finite etale Np-torsion and henselian equivalence lift its cyclic N-subgroup and all p+1 cyclic p-subgroups, after one finite extension. For each lifted C_p, the characteristic-zero quotient exists by SilvermanIII4.12/4.13.2. Its target has good reduction because it is isogenous to the good source. Extend quotient and dual to the abelian schemes. Their composites are[p], so their relative differential composites are multiplication by the unit p; hence each map is etale. Properness then makes it finite, with constant generic rank p. Its kernel specializes to the lifted C_p, and the torsor identity identifies the special target with the quotient by C_p. The prime-to-p N-level image is the transported enhancement. Apply the accepted generic unaveraged same-pi Hecke identity to this lifted enhanced point and all its p+1 quotients, and specialize using the extended pi. This gives exactly the neighbor sum at the original geometric point, retaining multiplicities even at automorphism points. Only one finite diagram at a time is lifted; no uniform extension or canonical lift is asserted.
